messages:
devon: Quick heads-up — ran the long-context synthetic suite this morning and seeing steady ~+12% RSS growth over 50k tokens on the KV paging test. nvprof trace attached but I wanted to surface here. Anyone seen this?

maria: ping @ben @cheng — did you notice anything odd in canary runs yesterday? :eyes:

ben: I noticed a small drift in the early runs but not linear like that. Can you paste the exact bench command and config you used?

devon: Sure — command I used:
```
./kvbench --mode=longcontext --seq=50000 --hotset=0.02 --read_write=0.8 --kv-size=8GB --enable-prefetch=false --iters=10
```

devon: Perf summary (RSS): 8.1GB -> 9.1GB -> 9.6GB -> 10.2GB across iterations. Process heap appears stable; growth is in the KV mmap region. KV hit rate stays ~98%.

cheng: Interesting. What does the reuse ratio look like over time? Any fragmentation counters?

devon: Reuse ratio: 0.86 -> 0.85 -> 0.84. Fragmentation (free-extents count): 12 -> 24 -> 39. So free extents increase steadily.

maria: Can you paste a /proc/<pid>/smaps excerpt for the KV region (just a few lines)?

devon: smaps excerpt:
```
7f8b00000000-7f8b80000000 rw-s 00000000 00:05 123456 /dev/shm/kv-shard-3
Size:                134217728 kB
Rss:                 10240000 kB
Pss:                 10240000 kB
Shared_Clean:         120000 kB
Shared_Dirty:         50000 kB
Private_Clean:       6000000 kB
Private_Dirty:       1300000 kB
KernelPageSize:           4096 kB
MMUPageSize:              65536 kB
AnonHugePages:        0 kB
AnonHugePages:        0 kB

```
(weirdly the private dirty portion creeps up between iterations)

ben: Could be compaction not triggering due to allocation/reuse pattern. Did you try forcing compaction? Also check if the mempool slab alignment changed after recent allocator work.

devon: I called kv_compact() between iterations; that drops free-extents from ~39 -> 6 and reuse ratio improves, but RSS stays ~+6% above baseline. So compaction re-links extents but doesn't return anon mmapped pages to kernel.

perf-ci-bot: perf run 2109876525 finished — test: kv_paging_longctx — regression +11% RSS (p=0.02). Details: https://perf.internal/runs/2109876525

cheng: Try enabling prefetch and also test with different slab sizes (16k/64k) — see if allocation granularity affects returning pages.

devon: Prefetch=true reduced growth to +3% but didn't completely stabilize. Slab=64k vs 16k had negligible effect.

ben: Any recent kernel selection changes? AVX512 path change landed yesterday that touched the allocator hotpath inlining. Could be subtle allocation size differences.

maria: @eng-runtime PR #4567 modified the allocator batching logic and landed yesterday afternoon.

devon: Reverted that change locally and the RSS growth disappears on the same synthetic run. Will produce a minimal repro and either revert or patch the allocator change.

cheng: Great find. Please add a regression test to the synth-suite that fails on the bad commit: 10 iterations, assert RSS delta < 2%. Tag it kv-longctx-rss-stability.

devon: Filing ticket INF-7893 and will open CL with test + repro snippets. I'll attach perf run links and smaps.

maria: :thumbsup: Please call out the commit hash in the CL description and ping infra to run the canary. If anyone else can validate on their machines that helps.

ben: I'll try to reproduce on my rig (different kernel) and report back.

perf-ci-bot: created issue INF-7893 with links to perf run and smaps.

devon: Thanks all — updating the CL now.
